gaps.summary: The authenticated API contract now requires request-scoped canvas_document_service_factory composition, but the deployed app sessionmaker/factory wiring is not yet proven.
gaps.completion_evidence: Production app composition supplies PostgresCanvasDocumentServiceFactory from the real SQLAlchemy sessionmaker and an integration request proves one Session per request with tenant isolation.

gaps.summary: Asset panel, Artifact drag, and system-file drop through NODE-18 upload/scanning lifecycle are not yet integrated into the Canvas surface.
gaps.completion_evidence: Browser E2E drops READY and SCANNING assets/files, renders placeholders correctly, and persists authorized asset references without trusting raw URLs.

gaps.summary: Move/selection/lock/delete/frame creation are wired, but complete resize/rotate handles, align/distribute, arrange, group/ungroup and generic copy/paste/duplicate product controls remain incomplete.
gaps.completion_evidence: Context toolbar/menu and keyboard E2E cover the canonical professional operation set with disabled-reason UX for locked/constraint-blocked targets.

gaps.summary: Bounded command buffering, same-batch retry, offline retry and explicit 409 reload are implemented, but PostgreSQL concurrency/restart E2E and optional semantic rebase are not yet proven.
gaps.completion_evidence: Two-session integration test proves no silent overwrite, retry-after-response-loss idempotency, offline reconnect version check, and canonical reload/rebase behavior.

gaps.summary: NODE-40 spatial culling/low-zoom simplification are reused, but the NODE-55 product flow has not executed the 2k-node browser interaction/performance acceptance.
gaps.completion_evidence: Performance harness opens a 2k-node document and records pan/zoom/select/drag responsiveness within the agreed product budget.

gaps.summary: Real browser autosave/version/AI-selection E2E and Hosted CI execution evidence are still required; repository runners have repeatedly failed before checkout with zero steps.
gaps.completion_evidence: NODE-55 workflow actually executes Python/TS tests, typecheck, lint/build and browser/integration gates with non-empty step logs.

gaps.summary: apps/web currently resolves @lumi/canvas-sdk and @lumi/design-ir through explicit monorepo source aliases so the frozen pnpm lock is not hand-edited; formal workspace dependency declarations require lock regeneration in a real pnpm environment.
gaps.completion_evidence: apps/web package.json declares workspace dependencies, pnpm-lock.yaml is regenerated by pinned pnpm 11.4.0, and frozen install/build succeeds.

gaps.summary: Exact historical ArtifactVersion projection is supported safely, but editing a non-head DesignDocumentVersion currently conflicts rather than offering an explicit fork/branch workflow.
gaps.completion_evidence: Product UX clearly chooses current-head reload or creates a new editable branch/version lineage from the historical exact artifact.

gaps.summary: Minimap, frame navigator, group-isolation breadcrumbs and command/search palette are not yet implemented.
gaps.completion_evidence: The agreed P1 navigation features are implemented and keyboard-accessibility tested.
